cards.title: HIV Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis in Solid Organ Transplant Recipients: An Overlooked Component of Long-Term Care.
cards.what: Sexual health and HIV prevention remain inconsistently addressed during follow-up after solid organ transplantation. This narrative review examines the potential role of HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) in transplant recipients with ongoing or anticipated HIV exposure.
cards.why: No clinical trials have evaluated PrEP in solid organ transplant recipients, but existing evidence supports individualized consideration.
cards.pkpd_hook: Tenofovir alafenamide/emtricitabine offers a more favorable renal profile, while long-acting cabotegravir avoids tenofovir exposure.
cards.original_title: HIV Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis in Solid Organ Transplant Recipients: An Overlooked Component of Long-Term Care.
cards.headline: HIV Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis in Solid Organ Transplant Recipients

cards.title: Hepatocyte-based models for cytochrome P450 fraction metabolized determination: Recommendations from the Quantitative Fraction Metabolized Working Group of the International Consortium for Innovation and Quality in Pharmaceutical Development.
cards.what: Accurate quantification of fraction metabolized (fm) by drug metabolizing enzymes is essential for understanding clearance mechanisms, predicting interindividual variability, and assessing victim drug-drug interaction (DDI) risk during drug discovery and development. Particularly, determining fm for metabolically stable, low turnover compounds remains challenging.
cards.why: Study highlights differences in intrinsic clearance, inhibitor response, and fraction metabolized predictions across hepatocyte systems.
cards.pkpd_hook: Differences in metabolite representation, inhibitor behavior, and effective inhibitor exposure may influence fm predictions.
cards.source: PubMed, Drug metabolism and disposition: the biological fate of chemicals

reason.text: In today's interaction: pralsetinib and posaconazole

used_for.text: Pralsetinib is a kinase inhibitor indicated for treatment of: Adult patients with metastatic rearranged during transfection (RET ) fusion-positive non-small cell lung cancer as detected by an FDA approved test (NSCLC). Adult and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older with advanced or metastatic RET fusion-positive thyroid cancer who require systemic therapy and who are radioactive iodine-refractory (if radioactive iodine is appropriate). This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on overall response rate and duration of response.

mechanisms.text: Coiled-coil domain-containing protein 6/Tyrosine-protein kinase receptor RET inhibitor
Kinesin-1 heavy chain/ Tyrosine-protein kinase receptor RET inhibitor

sentences: posaconazole is a strong inhibitor of CYP3A and pralsetinib is a moderate sensitive substrate of CYP3A, so pralsetinib exposure can be higher.
